# Lotería de los Pueblos

> Lotería de los Pueblos (https://app.loteria.to) is a free, no-account picture-lotería game with five spoken-language options: Nahuatl, Yucatec Maya, Cusco-Collao Quechua, Spanish and English. Coverage differs by language: all 144 cards have Spanish and English calls; the original 54 cards also have calls in the three Indigenous languages. Indigenous-language names are legacy drafts whose references remain unverified and have not been confirmed by native-speaker review. One person opens a room and others join from their phones with a QR code or 5-character code. Spanish and English audio uses Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0); Nahuatl, Yucatec Maya and Quechua audio uses Meta MMS-TTS (CC BY-NC 4.0, non-commercial use with attribution). Players can also play solo or print paper boards.

## Pages

- [Home: play, create or join a room](https://app.loteria.to/): create a room, join with a code, FAQ.
- [The 144 cards](https://app.loteria.to/deck): Spanish and English names for the full deck; Indigenous-language names appear on the original 54 cards.
- [Play solo](https://app.loteria.to/solo): offline game against 1 to 3 computer players.
- [Print boards](https://app.loteria.to/print): printable PDF boards for paper play.
- [Credits and licences](https://app.loteria.to/creditos): art, voices, typefaces, software and contributors.
